record.title: Chi Ma–Ai Diem halts freight clearance during March–April 2022 outbreak
record.region: East and Southeast Asia and Oceania
record.scope: Cargo clearance through Chi Ma–Ai Diem
record.direction: Both freight directions were reported suspended; the provincial daily report describes an inbound China-to-Vietnam shipment on 20 April, disputed by later ministry figures.
record.movement: Bilateral freight. Provincial daily reporting records one import and no exports on 20 April; the later ministry table records no imports. First complete restoration remains unresolved.
record.exceptions: New container-transfer protocol from April 21; first inbound shipment is not full reopening.
record.enforcement: The 15 March official exchange confirms that freight clearance could not occur. The provincial 20 April report records one import, conflicting with the later ministry table.
record.relationship: Separate from December and January Chi Ma spells. Does not duplicate Bac Luan II or Kim Thanh episodes.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; unknown endpoints are not extended to 21 October 2026.
record.official_rationale: COVID-19 case tracing and testing in Ningming.
record.context: Earlier March reports denied a closure before the afternoon14 March notice; March 13 traffic confirms that denial concerned a different time.
record.uncertainty: Official news uses April 21 for reopening; primary daily report and CAND account identify first import April 20. Publication date of daily PDF unrecovered; direct PDF access failed, substantive indexed text available. Later Finance Ministry correspondence gives March 15 onset (table says April 15) and zero imports April 20; contemporary local daily evidence is preferred but conflict prevents unqualified precision.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope.
